name: Weather
description: This is a simple weather app that provides a compact forecast view.
author: thooton

changes.text: Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
A place no longer shows another place's kept forecast, and Back in search deletes a letter.
Up and Down move two rows, and stop at the last day.
CARROT's weather on the XP3, from Open-Meteo.
Forecasts and place search from Open-Meteo, the phone's own position.
Word gaps in small text, scroll to the ten days.
The UI on sample forecasts, drawn as the mockups are.
